# R.K Digital Media

> R.K Digital Media is a digital marketing agency based in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, serving businesses across Noida, Delhi NCR, India and international markets.

- AI Automation Services: https://rkdigitalmedia.in/services/ai-automation

## Service Selection

- Google Ads: paid-search acquisition, campaign structure, keyword research, conversion tracking and optimisation.
- Google Ads Suspension Recovery: diagnosis of account, website and policy issues followed by corrective work and appeal preparation.
- SEO: technical SEO, search-intent mapping, on-page optimisation, content strategy and local SEO.
- Google Business Profile Management: profile setup and optimisation, categories, services, reviews, posts and local visibility.
- Website Development: business websites, landing pages, responsive UX, technical SEO foundations, analytics and conversion tracking.
- AI Automation: lead capture, qualification, routing, CRM workflows, follow-up and operational automation.
